              Fluent Bit Configuration
            

            fluent-bit.conf
          

          
[INPUT]
    Name        tail
    Path        /var/log/weblogic/*.log
    Tag         weblogic.server

[OUTPUT]
    Name        http
    Match       weblogic.*
    Host        127.0.0.1
    Port        8888
    URI         /api/ingest
    Header      X-LogOps-Key logops_key_live_default_9f83a2
    Header      Content-Type application/json
    Format      json

        


        

          

            

              
              Vector.dev Configuration
            

            vector.toml
          

          
[sources.kafka_logs]
type = "file"
include = ["/var/log/kafka/server.log"]

[sinks.logops_pipeline]
type = "http"
inputs = ["kafka_logs"]
uri = "http://127.0.0.1:8888/api/ingest"
method = "post"
headers.X-LogOps-Key = "logops_key_live_default_9f83a2"
encoding.codec = "json"

        


        

          

            

              
              Direct cURL Ingest Example
            

            REST API
          

          
curl -X POST http://localhost:8888/api/ingest \
  -H "X-LogOps-Key: logops_key_live_default_9f83a2" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "sourceType": "weblogic",
    "rawLogs": "####    <[STUCK] ExecuteThread: 12 failed>"
  }'

        


        

          

            

              
              PowerShell Windows Event Shipper
            

            shipper.ps1
          

          
$Event = Get-WinEvent -LogName "System" -MaxEvents 1
$Body = @{
    sourceType = "windows"
    rawLogs = $Event.Message
} | ConvertTo-Json

Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://localhost:8888/api/ingest" `
  -Method Post -Headers @{"X-LogOps-Key"="logops_key_live_default_9f83a2"} `
  -ContentType "application/json" -Body $Body

        

      

    


    
    

      

        

          
          Zero-Leak Architectural Security Blueprint
        

        

          LogOps acts as an air-tight operational intermediary between your private enterprise infrastructure and AI models.
          Raw log streams never touch LLMs directly. Sensitive PII, API tokens, internal hostnames, and IP addresses are intercepted,
          tokenized into cryptographically isolated vaults, sent safely to the model, and then rehydrated on egress back into actionable SRE playbooks.

               No Cloud Data Leaks
            

            

              Every log payload is scrubbed before leaving memory. Even if forwarding to an external LLM, the model only sees token references.
            

          


          

            

               Ephemeral Token Vaults
            

            

              Token mappings are isolated per pipeline invocation or session, preventing correlation attacks across different enterprise tenants.
            

          


          

            

               Domain-Tuned Diagnostics
            

            

              Parsers understand WebLogic stuck threads, Kafka consumer rebalances, Windows Event 4625 brute forces, and Jenkins Maven OOMs.
